sections.content:
Type: Fixed-term deposit with interest paid to the customer's account every month while the principal remains invested until maturity. Benefits:
• Receive a steady monthly income from interest payments.
• Guaranteed interest rate for the selected term.
• Safe and secure investment with predictable returns.
• Ideal for customers seeking regular cash flow without withdrawing their savings. Eligibility Criteria:
• Available to individual customers with a valid account.
• Minimum deposit amount 5000JD or 5000$ Classified as: CBoJ - Internal
• Funds must remain invested until the maturity date to receive the agreed benefits. Fees & Charges:
• No account opening or maintenance fees.
• Early withdrawal before maturity may result in reduced or forfeited interest, according to the bank's terms and conditions. How to Create It:
• Visit any bank branch or apply through the bank's Mobile APP
• Choose the deposit amount and preferred tenor.
• Review and accept the terms and conditions.
• Fund the deposit from an eligible account.
